questions.question_text:
A new vehicle has a market value of $\$56\,000$.
What is the stamp duty payable?

options.why: Calculated $5\%$ on the entire $\$56\,000$ without applying the $3\%$ rate up to $\$45\,000$.
Calculated $3\%$ on the entire $\$56\,000$ without applying the $5\%$ rate to the excess.
Calculated only the $5\%$ tax on the excess ($\$11\,000$) and omitted the $\$1350$ base duty.

questions.solution_text:
1. **Determine the taxable value**
$\text{Excess} = \$56\,000 - \$45\,000 = \$11\,000$
2. **Calculate the stamp duty**
$\text{Stamp Duty} = \$1350 + 0.05 \times \$11\,000$
$= \$1350 + \$550$
$= \$1900$
